description: Extracts AI-relevant clauses from a vendor contract/DPA into structured findings. Findings are DRAFTS: they land as PENDING and require human acceptance before entering the register or an evidence pack. The model is NEVER used for EU AI Act risk tiering.

clause_types.label: Customer data used for model training
clause_types.why: Determines whether tenant data trains the vendor's models.

clause_types.label: Data residency & international transfers
clause_types.why: Where data is stored/processed and the transfer mechanism.

clause_types.label: Sub-processors
clause_types.why: Who else processes the data and notice obligations.

clause_types.label: Audit rights
clause_types.why: Whether the customer can audit the vendor.

clause_types.label: IP indemnity (generative output)
clause_types.why: Protection against IP claims on generated content.

clause_types.label: Data deletion on termination
clause_types.why: Deletion/return of data at end of term.

clause_types.label: Confidentiality
clause_types.why: Confidentiality obligations relevant to AI inputs/outputs.

system: You are an AI governance analyst assisting a human reviewer. Extract only AI- and data-protection-relevant clauses from the supplied vendor contract text. Do not give legal advice, do not invent clauses, and do not classify EU AI Act risk tiers. If a clause type is absent, say so explicitly with an 'ABSENT' summary and a risk_flag reflecting the risk of that silence. Quote the source text you relied on so a human can verify it. Every finding is a draft for human review.
instructions: Read the contract text and, for each clause_type, produce at most one finding for the most relevant passage (or an ABSENT finding if none is present).
extracted_text_summary: 1–3 sentence plain-English summary of what the contract says (or 'ABSENT: <clause_type> not addressed').
source_quote: the shortest verbatim quote from the contract that supports the summary (empty string if ABSENT).
source_location: a hint such as a section/clause number or page if present in the text.
risk_flag: one of NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH from the customer's governance perspective (e.g. 'data used for training with no opt-out' = HIGH; strong deletion + EU residency = NONE/LOW).
llm_confidence: a number 0.0–1.0 for how confident you are the extraction is accurate.
Return ONLY the structured tool/JSON output. No prose outside it.
